language.label: Language
language.description: The language of Beacon Studio. Automatic follows the language of the browser.

defaultOutputFormat.label: Default output format
defaultOutputFormat.description: The output format of a new query block.

requireQueryFilters.label: Require a filter
requireQueryFilters.description: Blocks a query with no filters in the workbench. Beacon must not read a whole table.

queryCellLimit.label: Query cell limit
queryCellLimit.description: The cap on result size in cells (rows × columns). A lower value keeps the browser stable. The row limit is this value divided by the number of columns.

queryHistoryMax.label: Query history size
queryHistoryMax.description: The number of rows in the query history. The oldest runs go away first.

memoryCacheMaxEntries.label: Memory cache entries
memoryCacheMaxEntries.description: The number of decoded results that stay in memory.

workerMaxLoadedTables.label: Worker tables
workerMaxLoadedTables.description: The number of tables that the Arrow worker holds for sort and group actions.

diskCacheMaxEntries.label: Disk cache entries
diskCacheMaxEntries.description: The number of results in the browser disk cache (OPFS).

diskCacheMaxTotalBytes.label: Disk cache size
diskCacheMaxTotalBytes.description: The total size of the compressed results on disk.

diskCacheMaxAgeMs.label: Disk cache lifetime
diskCacheMaxAgeMs.description: The age at which a result on disk becomes stale. A stale result goes away.

mapStyleUrl.label: Base map style URL
mapStyleUrl.description: The MapLibre style URL of the base map. A change applies to the next map.

mapGroupByDecimals.label: Map group decimals
mapGroupByDecimals.description: The decimals that the map groups coordinates by. 4 = 11 m, 3 = 111 m, 2 = 1111 m, 1 = 11111 m, 0 = 111111 m.

crossSectionWidthKm.label: Cross section width
crossSectionWidthKm.description: The width of a new cross section band.

sampleAfterRows.label: Plot sample threshold
sampleAfterRows.description: The number of rows after which a plot samples the data. A lower value keeps the browser stable.

systemInfoUpdateIntervalMs.label: System info refresh
systemInfoUpdateIntervalMs.description: The period between two reads of the system info page.

telemetryEnabled.label: Send usage statistics
telemetryEnabled.description: The main switch. It sends usage events to beacon-datalake.org: page visits, query runs, downloads, searches, warnings and errors. A random id groups the events of this browser. It sends no account, no password and no result data. Switch this off to send nothing at all.

telemetryQueryDetails.label: Send query telemetry
telemetryQueryDetails.description: Adds the content of a query to its events: the table, the columns, the filters with their values, and the drawn area. It also covers a data browser search term. Switch this off to keep the usage statistics, but without that content. The app then reports that a query ran, with its time, its row count, its node and its number of columns and filters. It does not report which table or which values you asked for. An error message can still name a table. This switch does nothing while "Send usage statistics" is off.

telemetryConsoleLog.label: Include console.log output
telemetryConsoleLog.description: Adds console.log to the reported console output. Warnings and errors always go. Switch this on for a debug session only: a log line is noisy and it can hold a file path or a result value. This switch does nothing while "Send usage statistics" is off.

adminFeatures.label: Show admin features
adminFeatures.description: Shows the admin pages and the admin actions, for example dataset upload. An admin action asks for the admin username and password of the Beacon node.
